domain: MetaCore Business | Company AI Adoption | Organizational Deployment
purpose: Route requests about adopting MetaCore inside a business to the reusable company-integration model while preserving company source ownership, authority, privacy, minimum privilege, measured delta and controlled scale.
routing_rule: Treat the organization as a governed operational subject. Resolve mission -> company truth -> authority -> process -> minimum workbench/connections -> pilot -> measured delta -> scale. Do not preload or automate the whole company.

cross_routes.finance_claims: current company financial source owner + scoped finance expert
cross_routes.people_sensitive_data: company HR/data authority + minimum necessary access
cross_routes.physical_production: robotics/physical AI native safety when applicable

hard_boundaries: company source-of-truth remains authoritative for company facts
tool access is not decision authority
AI Persona is not autonomous executive authority
private company data is not stored in shared base_core
estimated gains remain hypotheses until measured
production writes/external commitments require explicit scoped approval
scale only after verified pilot delta
